$description: Where every tuned number in src/ came from. gates/check-provenance.mjs refuses a scalar constant that is not listed here, and refuses an entry whose recorded value no longer matches the source. Changing a number therefore means answering this question again, which is the whole point: the failure this register exists for is a chosen number that grows a reason afterwards. $documented holds the constants this gate cannot read mechanically, objects and arithmetic expressions, which other gates already check.

$kinds.measured: Derived from something this repository measures. The source names what was measured and where.
$kinds.inherited: Taken from the original artwork, with the audit entry that measured it.
$kinds.definition: True by construction. Changing it changes what the unit means.
$kinds.chosen: Somebody picked it. The source says who looked and when, or says that nobody has.

src/lockup.mjs:CAP.source: One cap height equals one stroke width, so a capital and the mark's limb are the same measure (docs/decisions.md D4).

src/lockup.mjs:GAP.source: The two original lockups used 0.983 and 0.862 cap heights for the same relationship. One is the rationalisation of both, and it moves the WavingEye lockup least (docs/asset-audit.md section 4, docs/decisions.md D4).

src/lockup.mjs:OPTICAL.source: Picked, not derived. Five settings from 0 to 1 rendered blind at 96 and 320 px and looked at by Sebastian on 2026-09-06; 0.4 could not be separated from 0.6 by eye and kept the field (issue #5). The earlier justification in the code, that the eye does not weigh area linearly, was invented after the fact and is removed.

src/lockup.mjs:STACK_RATIO.source: Picked, not derived, and nobody has looked at it. No measurement here supports it and it has had no blind comparison. Open.

src/baseline.mjs:WIDTH.source: The render width every baseline is compared at. Large enough that a third of a ninth is a pixel, small enough that 84 committed PNGs stay reviewable in a diff. Nothing depends on the exact figure.

src/mark.mjs:HORIZONTAL.source: Montserrat, the mark's own typeface, draws the H's crossbar at 41 px against a 44 px stem when the glyph is rendered 1200 px wide, read out of brand/fonts/Montserrat[wght].ttf with fontkit and resvg. Chosen over the figures quoted for the convention in general, which vary and which an earlier version of this work cited wrongly as 83 %.

src/mark.mjs:OUTLINE_MIN_PX.source: The outline holds two fully clear pixels from 30 px up and fails at every even size below, measured with check-legibility's method over 16 to 160 px. Every inset variant tried in issue #7 landed between 28 and 30, so the floor is a property of having three contours rather than of any weight. 32 is the next size a favicon slot offers. gates/check-legibility.mjs holds it.

src/mark.mjs:STANDARD.source: One outer stroke width is the unit, and it is nine ninths; every other integer in the grid is measured against it and checked by gates/check-geometry.mjs against brand/tokens/geometry.json (docs/asset-audit.md section 1, docs/decisions.md D2).

src/pdf.mjs:MM.source: 72 PostScript points per inch, 25.4 mm per inch. Not a choice.
